_about: The AI voices. Each is a blend of speakers from the pretrained Beatrice 2 model (LibriTTS-R readers, CC BY 4.0), mixed and moved so it isn't any one real person. mix: [[speaker, weight]]; formant: -2..2 semitones; pitch_hz: where auto pitch puts your voice; description: one line; about: a few lines for the voice list; tags: who it sounds like. model: the voice model download (only used if the add-on came without it).

voices.name: Bear
voices.about: A big man with a deep, heavy voice. Good for a tough guy, a boss or a gentle giant.

voices.name: Duke
voices.about: An older man with a low, gravelly voice. Good for a grandad, a wizard or a grumpy shopkeeper.

voices.name: Brick
voices.about: A rough, hard-edged man's voice with some grit in it. Good for soldiers, bouncers and grumpy characters.

voices.name: Max
voices.about: An ordinary grown man. The safest pick if you just want to sound like somebody else.

voices.name: Riley
voices.about: A lighter, younger man's voice, like someone in their late teens or early twenties.

voices.name: Atlas
voices.about: A calm, rich, deep man's voice, like a film trailer or a documentary. Good for narrating, a wise king or a game announcer.

voices.name: Sarge
voices.about: A hard, punchy man's voice made for shouting orders. Good for a drill sergeant, a coach or an angry boss.

voices.name: Moose
voices.about: A giant of a man with a big, open, booming voice, deeper than Bear. Good for a friendly giant, a lumberjack or a big boss.

voices.name: Bjorn
voices.about: A deep, rugged man's voice with a lot of chest. Good for a Viking, a warrior or a tough captain.

voices.name: Hank
voices.about: A low, relaxed man's voice with some weight to it. Good for a cowboy, a trucker or a calm old pro.

voices.name: Finn
voices.about: A strong man's voice with a rough edge, a little higher than Hank. Good for a pirate, a sailor or a loud adventurer.

voices.name: River
voices.about: Sits between a man's and a woman's voice, so it's hard to tell which. Good if you'd rather not be either.

voices.name: Ivy
voices.about: A woman with a low, slightly husky voice. Sounds older and cooler than Sage.

voices.name: Sage
voices.about: A grown woman with a calm, steady, low voice. Sounds relaxed and sure of herself.

voices.name: Nova
voices.about: A woman with a clear, soft voice. The everyday pick if you want to sound like a woman.

voices.name: Pixie
voices.about: A light, high, young-sounding voice. Good for cheerful or cartoon-like characters.

voices.name: Nana
voices.about: A grandma's voice: a little lower and softer than a young woman's. Good for a kind granny, a witch or an old shopkeeper.

voices.name: Zoe
voices.about: A bright, younger woman's voice, like someone in their late teens or early twenties.

voices.name: Onyx
voices.about: A woman with a deep, dark, smoky voice, lower than Ivy. Good for a villain, a spy or a mysterious stranger.

voices.name: Luna
voices.about: A clear, lively young woman's voice. Good for a pilot, a hero or a friendly guide.

voices.name: Vera
voices.about: A warm, full woman's voice with some depth to it. Good for a singer, a host or a confident boss.

voices.name: Poppy
voices.about: A cheerful, bouncy young woman's voice. Good for an excited friend, a streamer or a cheerful sidekick.

voices.name: Willow
voices.about: A soft, gentle woman's voice. Good for an elf, a healer or a calm storyteller.

voices.name: Hazel
voices.about: A higher woman's voice with an older, fuller tone. Good for a witch, a teacher or a fussy aunt.

voices.name: Daisy
voices.about: A sweet, friendly young woman's voice. Good for a farm girl, a shopkeeper or a kind neighbour.

voices.name: Squeak
voices.about: Very high and squeaky, like a chipmunk or a cartoon sidekick. Just for fun: nobody will think it's real.

voices.name: Bean
voices.about: A high, small voice like a young child. Higher than Pixie, not as squeaky as Squeak.

voices.name: Milo
voices.about: A high, young voice like a kid, a bit softer and rounder than Bean.

voices.name: Kiwi
voices.about: A very high, chirpy voice, a step below Squeak. Good for a parrot, a sprite or a cartoon pet.

voices.name: Titan
voices.about: Deeper than anyone really talks: a giant, an ogre or a monster. Best for laughs and villains, not for passing as a real person.
